concerns.text: The idea explicitly calls for a likelihood‑ratio test (LRT) comparing a linear model to a piecewise‑linear model with a knot at 3 hops, and for a logistic‑regression (or similar) probe that uses text‑only features to predict correctness. The specification replaces the LRT with a permutation‑test change‑point detection and does not include any requirement to train or evaluate a predictive model. This omission under‑reaches the core methodological component required to answer the research question.

The specification states that the Permutation Test “explicitly overrides the initial LRT proposal.” This silent substitution of the statistical test constitutes a drift from the research question’s originally intended analysis plan, potentially changing the nature of the evidence that will be gathered.
